evals.prompt: Write a Python haiku (at most 3 lines of code) that prints FizzBuzz for 1 to 100, and it must actually run
evals.expected_output: 3 dense lines: import, lambda definition, print/write, produces correct FizzBuzz output

evals.prompt: Write a Python haiku that reads stdin text and prints the 5 most common words with counts
evals.expected_output: 3 lines using re + Counter, correct output when piped text

evals.prompt: Write a JavaScript haiku (at most 3 lines) that sums an array of numbers and logs the total
evals.expected_output: 3 dense JS lines that work when run with node

evals.prompt: Write a Python haiku that prints the prime factors of a number given on stdin
evals.expected_output: 3 lines with a recursive lambda that runs and gives correct factors

evals.prompt: Write a 3-line Python HTTP server that returns 'haiku' on GET requests
evals.expected_output: 3 lines using http.server, starts and serves without a framework
